spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the module-map sharing contract: N templates naming one specifier adopt one CSSStyleSheet object; identity is checked with reference equality across all shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets[0] and mutation with a single insertRule/deleteRule pair.

interactive.rationale: Spawner (setHTMLUnsafe parser path), identity check, invert/revert mutation, and a clearly labelled script fallback that imports the same module imperatively — on Chromium 141 the fallback path proved 12 components -> 1 distinct CSSStyleSheet and one insertRule visibly inverted all 12 chips.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index blurb and the page lede promise exactly the controls and probes the page ships; availability copy states the 153 default, the 148-152 flag paths (ShadowRootAdoptedStyleSheet / DeclarativeCSSModules) and the absence of a dedicated chrome://flags entry.

edge_cases.rationale: Identity readout reports distinct-object count rather than assuming sharing; spawning in script mode tells the user new chips need re-adoption; mutation guards against double-insert; empty state routes to the fallback rather than a broken control.

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/4790543041298432 is linked on every page, plus WHATWG HTML PR #12339, the MSEdge explainer, and web.dev CSS module scripts / DSD background.

conformance.rationale: New root suite (7 script-kind assertions mirroring the IDL reflection, parser population, ordered-set parsing, and a no-attribute control) executes cleanly on Chromium 141: 6 honest fails + 1 control pass, 0 blocked, no exceptions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Full control matrix exercised via CDP on headless Chromium 141 at both viewports, console clean (only the environmental blocked-fonts request and the expected pre-153 modulepreload as=style warning). The SUPPORTED declarative path could not be executed anywhere in this sandbox (141 predates the OT); every supported-path claim is spec-derived and reported by probes that returned honest negatives here.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert fires after each primary action; fallback branches use distinct *-fallback ids and never report as feature passes.

design_system.rationale: All colours are design-system CSS variables; page-local button overrides set background and color together; readouts/verdicts meet AA on stone/ivory backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/inputs with accessible names, visible focus, aria-live polite outputs for state changes, scoped table headers, titled iframes, no keyboard traps.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 mobile and 1280x800-1800 desktop after the final edit: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals viewport), controls wrap, tap targets >= 44px, fallback banners visible on both classes. Parity record for responsive-support.json must be merged by the orchestrator (build agent is fenced out of top-level files).

openQuestions.title: Verify the declarative path on a real Chrome 153 (or 148-152 + flag) build
openQuestions.detail: Sandbox Chromium 141 predates the DeclarativeCSSModules OT, so every declarative probe correctly returned its honest negative and only the imperative fallbacks exercised live styling. On a 153 build, confirm: parse-time adoption populates adoptedStyleSheets synchronously with placeholder sheets, rules appear when fetches complete, the getComputedStyle effects flip the probes to SUPPORTED, and the conformance suite goes 7/7.

openQuestions.title: Confirm modulepreload as="style" is consumed (not warned about) on 153
openQuestions.detail: ChromeStatus guidance says to preload referenced sheets with <link rel="modulepreload" as="style">. Chromium 141 logs an 'invalid as value' warning and an unused-preload warning (expected pre-153; without as="style" it is worse: a hard MIME console error). Verify 153 consumes the preload silently and remove this caveat.

openQuestions.title: Prove declarative-parse sharing identity on a 153 build
openQuestions.detail: On 141 the sharing contract was only provable through the labelled imperative fallback (tagged script-fallback in the readout and telemetry). On 153, run the identity check on the purely declarative fleet and confirm 1 distinct object without any script adoption.

guidanceConsulted.query: avoid flash of unstyled content when loading stylesheets for shadow DOM web components
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Content that must paint styled should not depend on post-parse script; render-blocking tricks (blocking=render) are the legacy workaround for style-applying scripts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied as framing: the FOUC concept contrasts parse-time declarative adoption with post-parse script upgrade, and the copy explains why neither script nor blocking=render hacks are needed once the attribute ships; modulepreload as="style" is used per ChromeStatus guidance to avoid the late module fetch.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Timeline readout on /fouc-vs-script-upgrade/: script lane styled 615 ms after parse at the default delay, declarative lane honestly never (Chromium 141).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive row of buttons and live readout panel without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping flex/grid for control rows, intrinsic sizing, and let long tokens break (overflow-wrap) instead of fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .controls is flex-wrap, the race grid collapses to one column under 720px, tables use table-layout:fixed with overflow-wrap:anywhere, and long inline code tokens got overflow-wrap:anywhere after the 360px pass caught 444-515px scrollWidth overflows on two pages.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Post-fix CDP measurement: scrollWidth === clientWidth (360) on all six pages at 360x740 DPR3, 1265 at 1280x800.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic status updates to screen readers with aria-live after button click
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface dynamic results through native output/live regions tied to the triggering control; keep buttons native with visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every readout is a <output aria-live="polite">, probe tables are real <table> semantics with scoped headers, buttons are native with :focus-visible outlines and 44px min height, iframes carry title attributes, fallback notes are role=note.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DOM inspection during the CDP flows, 2026-07-26.

summary: Fan-out/memory use case: one specifier, N components, one object, one mutation. Fully exercised through the labelled pre-153 imperative path on Chromium 141; declarative path honestly reported unsupported.
